rows.row: S01 '..' through a symlinked folder that points outside ROOT: not bound to a ROOT file, listed unbound in record and verify
S02 '..' through a symlinked folder inside ROOT (lnk -> deep/x; lnk/../../inp/a.csv): bound to the file the OS reads; change caught
S03 --src=../../outside/o.csv (exists, outside ROOT): listed unbound with the verify note

detail.note: named in the command but outside ROOT: read by the run, never re-checked by verify

rows.row: S04 a '..' path that does not exist is not listed; the record carries an empty unbound_inputs
S05 '..' into .delivery is not bound as an input (the ledger is never an input)
S06 control: a fresh record verifies GO (r4 records carry unbound_inputs; verify reads it with .get, so r3 records without it still verify)
